_comment: Committed baseline for tests/scripts/install_friction_guard.test.ts (road-to-reachable-code-memory Phase 6). node:sqlite ships with Node itself — ADR-129's zero-new-dependencies promise means this snapshot must stay byte-identical for the SQLite substrate work; a real new runtime dependency requires updating this file deliberately, not as a side effect. One such deliberate update has happened since: `web-tree-sitter@0.24.7` was added on 2026-09-08 under ADR-259 (accepted, owner-directed, already on the trunk), which supersedes ADR-246 and moves the parser runtime from devDependencies to dependencies so a consumer install can actually load a grammar. ADR-129's promise is about the SQLite substrate and is untouched by it; the byte-identity sentence above should be read as scoped to that work rather than as a claim that this file never changes. A second deliberate update: `graphology`, `graphology-communities-louvain` and `graphology-layout-forceatlas2` were added on 2026-10-23 under ADR-297 for the code map's community detection and layout; they are pure JavaScript with no lifecycle scripts. A third deliberate update, on 2026-10-24: `zod` moved from ^3.25.0 to ^4.6.6 to clear the zod 3 advisory, and `zod-to-json-schema` was removed because zod 4 converts natively (`z.toJSONSchema`); the dependency count went down by one.
